source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 753 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-753.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 753 was established by Ordinance No. 26526, passed by the Dallas City Council on December 13, 2006. (Ord. 26526)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-753.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 753 is established on property located on the east line of Preston Road, between Arapaho Road and Keller Springs Road. The size of PD 753 is approximately 4.136 acres. (Ord. 26526)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-753.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a nonresidential zoning district. (Ord. 26526)

sections.title: Development Plan And Elevations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-753.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN AND ELEVATIONS.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 753A) and elevations (Exhibit 753D). In the event of a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls. In the event of a conflict between the text of this article and the elevations, the text of this article controls. (Ord. 26526)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-753.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

The following uses are the only main uses permitted in this district:

(1) Agricultural uses.

-- None permitted.

(2) Commercial and business service uses.

-- None permitted.

(3) Industrial uses.

-- None permitted.

(4) Institutional and community service uses.

-- Adult day care facility. [L] -- Church. -- Library, art gallery, or museum.

(5) Lodging uses.

-- None permitted.

(6) Miscellaneous uses.

-- Temporary construction or sales office.

(7) Office uses.

-- Financial institution without drive-in window. -- Medical clinic or ambulatory surgical center. [This use is permitted to operate only between 8 a.m. and 6 p.m., Monday through Saturday.] -- Office.

(8) Recreation uses.

-- None permitted.

(9) Residential uses.

-- None permitted.

(10) Retail and personal service uses.

-- Personal service uses. [Permitted as a limited use only, up to a maximum floor area of 1,000 square feet.]

(11) Transportation uses.

-- Transit passenger shelter.

(12) Utility and public service uses.

-- Local utilities. [SUP or RAR may be required. See Section 51A- 4.212(4).]

(13) Wholesale, distribution, and storage uses.

-- Recycling drop-off container. [SUP required if the requirements of Section 51A-4.213(11.2)(E) are not satisfied.] -- Recycling drop-off for special occasion collection. [SUP required if the requirements of Section 51A-4.213(11.3)(E) are not satisfied.] (Ord. 26526)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-753.106. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A- 4.217.

(b) The following accessory uses are not permitted in this district:

-- Accessory community center (private). -- Accessory helistop. -- Accessory medical/infectious waste incinerator. -- Accessory outside display of merchandise. -- Accessory outside sales. -- Accessory pathological waste incinerator. -- Amateur communication tower. -- Home occupation. -- Private stable. (Ord. 26526)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-753.107. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations in Section 51A-4.121(a), “Neighborhood Office [NO(A)] District,” apply.

(b) Floor area. Maximum floor area is 11,500 square feet, excluding balconies.

(c) Stories. Maximum number of stories is one, whether located wholly or partially above or below grade. (Ord. 26526)

sections.title: Off Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-753.108. OFF STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Consult the use regulations in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use. (Ord. 26526)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-753.109. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 26526)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-753.110. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Landscaping must be provided as shown on the landscape plan (Exhibit 753B).

(b) Tree preservation, removal, and replacement must comply with Division 51A-10.130, "Tree Preservation, Removal, and Replacement," and the tree mitigation plan (Exhibit 753C).

(c) In the event of a conflict between Division 51A-10.130 and the tree mitigation plan, the tree mitigation plan controls. In the event of a conflict between the landscape plan and the tree mitigation plan, the landscape plan controls.

(d) Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. 26526)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-753.111. SIGNS.

(a) Except as provided in this section, signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts in Article VII.

(b) Detached signs are limited to one monument sign with a maximum height of seven feet and a maximum effective area of 20 square feet.

(c) Attached signs are limited to six attached signs on the west facade of a building on the Property, with a combined maximum effective area of 80 square feet.

(d) Special purpose signs are prohibited. (Ord. 26526)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-753.112. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) Parking lot, landscape, and security lighting must contain a shield to control lighting, concealing the light source and directing light away from the adjacent residential lots to the east and south.

(b) Highly reflective glass with an exterior visible reflectance percentages in excess of 27 percent is prohibited. Visible reflectance percentage is the percentage of available visible light energy reflected away from the exterior surface of the glass.

(c) A maximum of one balcony is permitted in the location shown on the development plan only, with a maximum floor area of 1,000 square feet.

(d) The board of adjustment may not consider any special exceptions for the Property.

(e) At least 30 days prior to filing an application for a minor amendment to an approved development plan or landscape plan, the applicant must provide a copy of the application and any plan to Harold Leidner, 5931 Warm Mist Lane, Dallas Texas, 75248. The address for this notice may be revised by written notice to the director and the Property owner from Harold Leidner.

(f) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(g) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the City of Dallas. (Ord. 26526)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-753.113. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, in this district until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 26526)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-753.114. ZONING MAP.

PD 753 is located on Zoning Map No. B-7. (Ord. 26526)
